 ---- Applicant  Versus  State of Chhatisgarh, through the Police Station - Jute Mill, District  Raigarh (C.G.)
 ----Non-applicant For Applicant : Mr. Hari Agrawal, Advocate.

For Non-applicant : Mr. Suyashdhar Badgaiya, Dy. Govt. Advocate.
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi  Order On Board 15-07-2024  Heard.
1.
The applicant has preferred this first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail as he is arrested on 10.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.
49/2024 registered at police station Jute Mill, District Raigarh (C.G.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 408 of the Indian Penal Code.
His anticipatory bail application was rejected by this Court vide order dated 19.04.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. (A) No. 237 of 2024.

sentences.text: Facts of the case, in brief, are that on 26.01.2024 complainant Ravi Kumar Suryawanshi, the then Branch Manager of Vector Finance Private Limited, Branch Savitri Nagar, Raigarh lodged FIR against the present Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25389 applicant alleging that present applicant was posted as Branch Manager in aforesaid company from 18.02.2021 to 01.07.2023, in between, he misappropriated a sum of Rs. 2,11,312/-, which was deposited by the customers of the aforesaid Finance Company and thereby he committed criminal breach of trust.
Based on above facts, present crime has been registered against the present applicant.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant would submit that applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case, as he has not embezzled any amount.

He would submit that in Crime No. 241 / 2023 under Section 376 of the IPC, the applicant has been falsely implicated, but he was arrested in aforesaid case and prior to his arrest in aforesaid case, he had deposited all the amounts collected from investors (Mahila Swa Sahayata Samuh) i.e. about Rs. 96,000/-, which was deposited by applicant in the account of aforesaid Bank, but since, in audit, an amount of Rs.2,11,312/- was found missing, therefore, after getting bail in aforesaid criminal case (Crime No. 241/2023), when he wants to join his services, then he was pressurized by the then Branch Manager to deposit more amount.

In this regard, applicant made complaint through E-Mail (Annexure A-5) dated 29.11.2023 to the superior Officer of Head Office, Kolkata, therefore, as a counter blast present FIR has been lodged against him.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, having regard to the facts & circumstances of the case, particularly considering the present FIR bearing Crime No. 49 /2024, which shows that earlier applicant made complaint against Area Manager and other local officials of Vector Finance Private Limited through E-Mail (Annexure A-5) dated 29.11.2023 to the superior Officer of Head Office,
Kolkata, thereafter, as counter blast on 26.01.2024, present FIR was lodged by complainant against the applicant; further considering the facts that applicant is in jail since 10.06.2024; I feel inclined to allow the bail application filed by the applicant.
6.

Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. is allowed and the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
He is directed to appear before the trial Court on each and every date given by the said Court.

Sd/-
(Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi) Judge Amit/-
